description: This file provides functions and classes for bundling and inflating model inputs in PyTorch, including handling of tensors and custom inflation expressions, as well as methods for augmenting scripted modules with bundled input data.

classes.name: InflatableArg
classes.description: Helper class for representing bundled inputs with custom inflation logic.

methods.name: bundle_inputs
methods.description: Creates a copy of a scripted model with bundled inputs attached, supporting various input formats and metadata.

methods.name: augment_model_with_bundled_inputs
methods.description: Adds bundled sample inputs to a model for its forward function, enabling uniform invocation.

methods.name: augment_many_model_functions_with_bundled_inputs
methods.description: Adds bundled inputs for multiple specified functions of a model, supporting custom inflation and metadata.

methods.name: bundle_randn
methods.description: Generates an InflatableArg wrapping a tensor that will be inflated with torch.randn_like.

methods.name: bundle_large_tensor
methods.description: Wraps a tensor in an InflatableArg to allow bundling regardless of size.
